About the company
 
 Our client is a venture-backed spatial intelligence company building foundation models for physical engineering design. Its first model is a generative foundation model for structured 3D parametric CAD, and the team is now developing the next generation of its system. Founded in 2022 and backed with $27M in funding, the company has grown from six people at its last financing to a highly technical team of 12.
 
 The role and why it matters
 
 This is a broad new-graduate engineering role for someone with strong fundamentals and the curiosity to work across machine learning, geometry, graphics, data systems, evaluation, and internal tooling. You will begin with well-scoped projects, learn the full system, and take on more ownership as you demonstrate strength. No CAD or manufacturing background is required.
 
 What you'll do
 
 • Build and maintain geometry and data pipelines that parse CAD, convert formats, extract features, and verify output quality.
 • Write evaluation harnesses and tooling that help the team determine whether model performance has improved.
 • Support machine learning training and experiment runs, instrument systems, debug failures, and present results clearly.
 • Build internal tools that remove friction for researchers and engineers.
 • Work across the stack and develop depth in the areas where you have the greatest impact.
 • Own challenging technical problems in close collaboration with a small, experienced team.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 
 • Zero to two years of software engineering experience, including internships or research.
 • A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics, or a closely related field from a rigorous program.
 • Hands-on experience with machine learning training, data pipelines, internal tooling, or adjacent technical work.
 • Strong programming ability in Python and/or C or C++.
 • Evidence of high performance through internships, research, ambitious technical projects, or work in a demanding engineering environment.
 • A generalist mindset, intellectual curiosity, and willingness to begin broadly before specializing.
 • A track record of finishing difficult work and taking initiative without waiting for detailed instructions.
 
 Bonus points
 
 • Exposure to CAD, computational geometry, robotics, perception, graphics, game development, or related coursework and projects.
 • Experience building evaluation systems or supporting model training infrastructure.
 • Research or internship experience at a high-bar technology company or laboratory.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 
 • $150K-$220K base salary.
 • Total compensation around $300K, including bonus.
 • Competitive equity and benefits.
 • Visa sponsorship and transfers may be available, including F-1 OPT, H-1B transfers, new H-1B sponsorship, and TN visas.
 
 Location and work model
 
 This is a full-time role based in San Francisco, California. The team works together in the office five days per week, and candidates must be able to work on-site or relocate before starting.
